desc: A storeroom, dim and close. The air is cool. Ways out: a door east and the way out. We took everything loose: jar, token, wood, two provisions.
name: Storeroom
notes: Placed below the village for drawing only; its real position is unknown. Third look: "The air is cool."
statusNote: Looked until nothing new and took everything. Come back to the wall's 154 marks once we can fill the worn ones.
